stumbles.quote: The client could not retry it because the retry count has been 0 since a refactor on 2026-09-14.
stumbles.why: Refers to an unexplained refactor and a retry count setting. It doesn't say where the count is configured or why it became 0. It also sits oddly with the Change section, which says `execute()` now retries up to 4 times, without saying the count was changed.

stumbles.quote: Boot read that 503 as a credential failure and printed "auth failed".
stumbles.why: "Boot" is never explained. It could be a startup routine, a script or a component. It's unclear how it relates to `execute()` or why it turns a 503 into an auth error.

This is ambiguous against "retries ... up to 4 times". Four 503s would be the initial try plus three retries, which would not exhaust 4 retries. It's unclear whether the test covers four total responses or five.
The text doesn't say what the public API is. It also says the error message now names the status code, which may change observable behavior.

point: The PR makes Turso's `execute()` retry HTTP 503 and 429 with jittered backoff, so cold-start 503s no longer show up as \"auth failed\" at boot. It backs this with 40 cold-boot runs and 6 new tests.
